title: Seven + Holliday: Bullet Resist Shredder on Seven, Spirit Shredder/Rend on Holliday
question: Does Seven's spirit AoE keep Bullet Resist Shredder on Holliday's targets, and does Holliday's Spirit Shredder/Rend raise Seven's damage on her target?
hypothesis: H-B2-3.1: Holliday gun damage on 3 bots hit by Lightning Ball/Storm Cloud is >=8% higher with Seven's BRS than with base Holliday's own BRS. H-B2-3.2: BRS from two owners refreshes (-10%), not stacks (-20%): debuff panel. H-B2-3.3: Seven's Storm Cloud damage on Holliday's headshot target is >=6% higher with Spirit Shredder and >=25% higher with Spirit Rend at 4 stacks.

setup.position: 3 bots clumped 25m from Holliday; Seven 15m from them

controls: Cooldowns, HP and debuffs reset between trials
Same boons/souls/ability points in both arms except the item under test
Same bot heroes, HP and resists
procedure: Seven throws Lightning Ball into the clump and casts Storm Cloud
Holliday headshots bot 1 for 8s (one shot per second or faster)
Read Holliday damage on all 3 bots, Seven damage on bot 1, and the debuff panel on bot 1

decision.rule: SUPPORTS if duo_pair beats base_pair on Seven damage by >=20% with non-overlapping ranges and Holliday damage is not lower by >3%; REFUTES if Seven gains <6%; else INCONCLUSIVE.
